packageRules.description: pnpm/npm override entries (pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides, package.json pnpm.overrides/overrides) are hand-authored remediations keyed by version *selector*, not package name -- e.g. "yaml@1": "1.10.3" pins consumers resolving into the yaml v1 line, it isn't a package named yaml@1. Renovate misreads the selector as a literal package name and proposes cross-major bumps that invert the override's purpose, and rewrites floor+cap ranges into bare caps, dropping the security floor (see commercetools/nimbus#1928 for observed breakage). Suppress majors here: minor/patch still flow, and vulnerabilityAlerts/osvVulnerabilityAlerts bypass this for genuine CVE remediation. Crossing a major on an override band must be done by hand, verifying the actual transitive consumers.
